evidence: Analysis ran on Databricks (table workspace.mlpabaf0ca5.training_data, built from the CSV uploaded to volume workspace.mlpabaf0ca5.raw). Pearson correlation with the label computed on the SQL warehouse: f1=0.020, f2=0.111, f3=0.011, f4=0.993, f5=0.077, f6=-0.002. A rank-sum (Mann-Whitney) AUC computed in SQL shows f4 alone separates the classes perfectly (AUC = 1.0 over 287 positives / 800 rows), i.e. a single threshold on f4 predicts the label exactly — far too strong for a legitimate pre-outcome feature, consistent with f4 being computed from post-outcome data.
